text:
For the decay at rest,

\[
\pi^+ \to \mu^+ + \nu
\]

take the neutrino mass as negligible. The energy release is

\[
Q = m_\pi - m_\mu = 139.6 - 105.7 = 33.9\text{ MeV}.
\]

For two-body decay from rest,

\[
K_\mu=\frac{(m_\pi-m_\mu)^2}{2m_\pi}
=\frac{(33.9)^2}{2(139.6)}
\approx 4.12\text{ MeV}.
\]

Then

\[
K_\nu \approx Q-K_\mu = 33.9-4.12 \approx 29.8\text{ MeV}.
\]

So the kinetic energies are approximately \(4.12\text{ MeV}\) for \(\mu^+\) and \(29.8\text{ MeV}\) for \(\nu\).

Answer: A
